_note: Before-service (visit heads-up) copy for Worker lawndoctor-before-service. Draft for Ty's approval from the test email. Tokens: {{FirstName}} {{VisitDay}} (e.g. Monday, October 19) {{VisitShort}} (e.g. Mon Oct 19). Texts must stay plain ASCII and under 160 characters; the Worker uses sms_short if sms is too long.
subject: {{FirstName}}, your Lawn Doctor visit is {{VisitDay}}
pre: A quick heads-up and a few things that help the visit go smoothly.
headline: Your visit is scheduled, {{FirstName}}
intro: Hi {{FirstName}}, this is a quick heads-up that your Lawn Doctor visit is on the schedule for {{VisitDay}}. You don't need to be home. Here's what we'll be doing and a few things that help.
after: After the visit, you'll get an email with what we did and any care instructions.
closing: Need to reschedule or have a question? Just reply to this email or call us at 385-463-2430.
sms: Lawn Doctor: Hi {{FirstName}}, your visit is scheduled for {{VisitShort}}. Please unlock gates and keep pets inside. Questions? Reply here.
sms_short: Lawn Doctor: Your visit is scheduled for {{VisitShort}}. Please unlock gates and keep pets inside. Questions? Reply here.

general: Unlock gates so we can reach every part of the yard
Keep pets inside while we're there
lawn: Mow 1 to 2 days before if you can
Skip watering the morning of the visit
aeration: Flag sprinkler heads, invisible dog fences and any buried lines so we can avoid them
Water the lawn 1 to 2 days before so the soil is soft
seed: Mow short 1 to 2 days before so the seed reaches the soil
blowout: Make sure we can reach your sprinkler controller and the main water shutoff
Leave the controller on so we can run each zone
mosquito: Bring in pet bowls, toys and anything you don't want treated
pest: Move items away from the foundation of your home if you can
tree: Bring in pet bowls and toys near trees and shrubs
